Tempering — Hardness Meets Toughness

Hardening alone leaves steel brittle. Tempering is the controlled step that turns raw hardness into dependable performance.

Precision Tempering

After hardening, parts are tempered in controlled furnace cycles to hit the exact hardness specification your application demands — trading a measured amount of peak hardness for the toughness and impact resistance that keep components working under load instead of cracking under it.

Every tempering cycle is documented and verified: furnace cycles are controlled, hardness is verified on the finished parts, and lots are tracked from receipt to return.

Rifle Barrels Bolt Carrier Groups Triggers & Fire Control Gears · Pins · Shafts

What tempering delivers

  • Optimizes the hardness / toughness balance
  • Improves impact resistance
  • Reduces brittleness
  • Enhances reliability

Paired with

  • Vacuum hardening for a clean, bright finish
  • Stress relieving to minimize distortion
  • Hardness verification on every lot
